findings.title: rubric.json embeds hardcoded Supabase project ID exswghbtgtdykklcsdxq
findings.detail: rubric.json online_eval_log_schema.project is a hardcoded Supabase project ID. While project IDs are not secret keys, embedding infrastructure identifiers in spec files creates drift when the project changes (e.g., staging vs prod vs new tenant). A reference like '${SUPABASE_PROJECT_ID}' or a comment noting this as the production project ID would be more maintainable.
findings.notes: Not fixed this session. The project ID is documentation-appropriate in rubric.json as it identifies where the online_eval_log lives. However, if rubric.json ever becomes a portable template, this would need parameterization. Sebastian to decide: leave as documentation or parameterize.

findings.detail: lane-lock.sh is referenced as a required dependency for race-condition-safe closed.json writes. The file lives at ~/.claude/scripts/lane-lock.sh (Sebastian's local machine, not in this repo). If the file is absent on a new machine, the locking requirement silently fails — no error, just no lock. Cannot verify existence from this repo.
findings.notes: Cannot fix — lane-lock.sh is a local machine script, not in this repo. Recommend verifying its existence in a setup checklist or README, or vendoring a copy into this repo.
